verdict.rationale: Pilot's FAQ says it can provide consolidated reporting for US entities with foreign subsidiaries, so it directly offers consolidated financials across entities. That is one brief line covering a single parent-subsidiary scenario, with no detail on how multiple legal entities are managed. Missing for 10: documentation of multi-entity management (separate books per entity, intercompany eliminations), consolidation beyond the US-parent/foreign-subsidiary case, depth of the consolidated report outputs, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can manage multiple legal entities and produce consolidated financials across them

citations.quote: We can also provide US entities with foreign subsidiaries with consolidated reporting.
